$description: EIJA Studio colour tokens, colour-system aspect (HCI-ADR 0059). DTCG 2025.10 (Final Community Group Report, not a W3C Standard). Each colour is OKLCH components plus a 6-digit hex fallback; contrast and CVD rules are evaluated on the hex. Light and dark ship together. All values are PREDICTION-grade: no user study exists.

raised.$description: Elevation 1: panels that encode grouping, decision surface.

overlay.$description: Elevation 2: palette, menus, popovers. Light theme has the same fill as raised and is set apart by a 1 px border.control edge, no shadow; dark theme uses the lighter step plus the same edge.

sunken.$description: Recessed ground for source, diff and code views.

primary.$description: Body text and every status word.

secondary.$description: Metadata and labels. Passes WCAG 4.5 and the APCA advisory Lc 60 on all four surfaces.

disabled.$description: Inactive controls only. Exempt from SC 1.4.3; never used for information.

subtle.$description: Decorative hairline; not a component boundary.

control.$description: Boundary of inputs and buttons. At least 3:1 on every surface (SC 1.4.11).

fg.$description: The one accent hue (OKLCH hue 250). Links, selection edge, focus ring, proposed and running marks.

solid.$description: Fill of the one primary button per view; identical to accent.fg by decision. It is a style token only: no AI or provider surface may render Approve or Apply in any style.

ring.$description: Focus ring: 2 px with 2 px offset so the adjacent colour is a surface.

wash.$description: Selected row or node wash; edge uses accent.fg.

fg.$description: Kernel evidence PASS within its stated bound. Quietest status by design.

tint.$description: Wash for at most one region per viewport; text on it is text.primary.

fg.$description: Kernel evidence FAIL: a check refuted the claim. Loudest chromatic status.

tint.$description: Wash for at most one region per viewport; text on it is text.primary.

fg.$description: Kernel evidence UNKNOWN: no authority or no result. Neutral, never tinted like a pass. Count always shown, including zero.

tint.$description: Wash for at most one region per viewport; text on it is text.primary.

fg.$description: Kernel evidence STALE: only receipts for an older revision exist. Previous verdict stays visible.

tint.$description: Wash for at most one region per viewport; text on it is text.primary.

fg.$description: Kernel evidence CONFLICT: sources disagree. Own hue and own glyph, not a variant of FAIL.

tint.$description: Wash for at most one region per viewport; text on it is text.primary.

fg.$description: NOT_RUN: check was not attempted. Lowest emphasis; never counted as PASS.

tint.$description: Wash for at most one region per viewport; text on it is text.primary.

fg.$description: Eligibility BLOCKED (not evidence). Reason is shown at disclosure level 0.

io.github.45ck.eija-studio.label: PREDICTION-grade: computed from these tokens, not measured on people

spec.dtcg: 2025.10 (Final Community Group Report, not a W3C Standard)
spec.fallback: 6-digit sRGB hex; all values are inside sRGB, no P3 tokens
spec.themes: the Format module has no modes; light and dark are sibling groups and a generator maps them to CSS light-dark()

hue_anchors_oklch_deg.category: nominal hues 25 + 45k degrees (25 70 115 160 205 250 295 340), used in the order 205 70 295 25 115 160 250 340; category.1 realises as OKLCH hue 206 in light and 205 in dark

io.github.45ck.eija-studio.cvd_model: Machado, Oliveira and Fernandes 2009 matrices; the authors' page does not say whether they act on linear or gamma-encoded sRGB, so every criterion takes the worse of both

requirements.name: Body and secondary text on every surface
Text on every wash
requirements.note: status words and diff text use text.primary; design floor for text.primary on washes is 7

requirements.name: Non-text marks on every surface
requirements.note: decorative border.subtle and text.disabled are exempt; design floor for status, diff and accent glyph colour is 4.5 except not-run (3.15)

requirements.name: Glyph colour on its own wash
Text on the accent fill and focus ring on the selection wash
APCA lightness contrast, advisory
requirements.source: APCA in a Nutshell (unratified); not a gate; code not vendored
requirements.note: minimum of the absolute Lc over the four surfaces, text on background, computed with the W3 reference implementation apca-w3 0.1.9 (revision 2022-07-03); oracles black on white 106.04, white on black -107.88, #262422 on #F8F6F4 97.21. Status set: pass, fail, unknown, stale, conflict, blocked, proposed, running

requirements.name: Worst-case CVD hue separation between any two of the 8 statuses
requirements.note: set: 8 colours (proposed and running share the accent hex, so running has the same pair distances as proposed and 0 to proposed, told apart by form and word). conditions: normal; protan, deutan, tritan at severity 50 and 100, matrices applied to linear and to gamma-encoded sRGB, worst case of both. At severities 10 to 100 step 10 the worst pairs are 0.0612 (light) and 0.0448 (dark, pass against not-run, deutan 90, gamma). Threshold is 2 x JND, our choice. The same 8 statuses reach only 6.95 (light) and 6.60 (dark) in CAM02-UCS (5 chromatic: 9.23 and 8.19), against 13.06 for the categories; status is redundantly coded, so this is a floor for an added channel

requirements.name: Glyph silhouette distance between any two statuses (greyscale, 12 px)
requirements.source: own metric; glyph geometry owned by the status-display aspect
requirements.note: set: pass, fail, conflict, stale, unknown, not-run, running (evidence aspect glyph table) plus a provisional BLOCKED glyph, 8 in all: 0.313 at 12 px, 0.334 at 16 px. AI-proposed is a dashed outline, not a glyph, and is not in this set; the COL-07 set has proposed and no running. Rerun both on one set once the status-display aspect fixes glyphs. Light UNKNOWN and BLOCKED are near-ink (#3E3E3E, #2E2E2E) and are separated by silhouette only

requirements.name: Diff hues kept apart from status and accent hues
requirements.source: own; placement grammar in docs/hci/design/color-system.md section 3

requirements.name: Categorical marks (8) are CVD-separable and legible
requirements.source: Petroff 2021 (18 for 8 colours without a 3:1 rule); conditions: normal; protan, deutan, tritan at severities 10 to 100 step 10

requirements.name: Dark elevation by surface step, not shadow
requirements.source: measured shadow contrast on dark, visual-design-foundations dossier 2.5

requirements.name: Neutrals stay neutral
requirements.source: own; status.unknown, not-run and blocked have chroma 0

requirements.name: Token file validity and hex fallback
requirements.note: colorSpace oklch; components [L, C, H or none]; alpha 1; 6-digit hex; hex equals the sRGB conversion of components within 1/255

requirements.name: Light and dark parity
requirements.note: identical token paths in both themes; no token exists in one theme only

option_c_ladder_hex.note: contrast-tier ladder palette of ADR 0059 option C, rebuilt from its spec (tiers fail 7.0, conflict 6.0, unknown 8.0, blocked 11.0, accent 5.6, pass 4.55, stale 4.6, not-run 4.6; hues 165, 40, 85, 350, 250; chroma caps 0.13 to 0.16). It was not optimised for the CVD metric; the chosen palette was. Worst pair over 28, severities 50 and 100, both conventions: 0.024 light, 0.021 dark (linear convention; 0.030 and 0.022 under the gamma convention)
